# jamfplatform_pro_user_group (List Resource)

Lists Jamf Pro user groups. Supply an optional case-insensitive `name_substring` filter applied client-side after the full list is fetched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every Jamf Pro user group.
list "jamfplatform_pro_user_group" "all" {
  provider = jamfplatform
}

# List user groups whose name contains the substring "Apple" (case-insensitive).
list "jamfplatform_pro_user_group" "apple_like" {
  provider = jamfplatform

  config {
    filter = {
      name_substring = "Apple"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Attributes) Optional case-insensitive `name_substring` filter applied client-side after the full list is fetched. For exact-name lookup, use the singular `by name` data source instead. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `name_substring` (String) Case-insensitive substring matched against the resource's display name. Empty or omitted returns every item.
